scoring_justification: The output contract provides only final summary values (torsion, HFC constants, barrier, averaged coupling) without raw scan data needed for recomputation. Result-level comparison against paper-reported gold with tolerances is acceptable.

schema.description: Optimized XYZ coordinates followed by a line giving the HNSiH torsion angle. The checker parses the final line for the angle value and compares it to the hidden gold within a tolerance.

outputs.description: Optimized geometry and HNSiH torsion angle.
Equilibrium isotropic hyperfine coupling constants for ²⁹Si, ¹⁴N, and ¹H (in Gauss).

schema.description: Single line 'barrier: <value>'. The checker extracts the barrier value (kcal/mol) and compares it to the hidden gold within a tolerance.
Single line 'a_iso_N_300K: <value>'. The checker extracts the averaged ¹⁴N isotropic coupling (Gauss) and compares it to the hidden gold within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are compared to the reference DFT‑computed values from the paper. Tolerances absorb legitimate toolchain spread. The load‑bearing step (step_04) forces genuine execution of the full workflow.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold target values for HNSiH torsion, equilibrium HFC constants, rotation barrier bound, and temperature-averaged 14N coupling.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and accompanying text (Radtsig, 2005). HNSiH torsion 145.2°, a_iso(29Si) -391.4 G, a_iso(14N) 8.8 G, a_iso(1H) -3.8 G, barrier ≤2 kcal/mol, averaged a_iso(14N) at 300 K = 11.2 G.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper; barrier upper bound translated to threshold.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own computed DFT results used to support the radical assignment; they are the target of the reproduction.

steps.description: NH2 rotation barrier: must be <= ~2 kcal/mol
